verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents that backup data 'can be encrypted with your password' (so the vendor need not hold the key) and offers a 'Decryption Kit' for vault recovery, plus source-available code for independent verification, but there is no detailed whitepaper or technical spec describing the actual encryption scheme, key derivation, or threat model. Community commentary (HN) also raises unresolved skepticism about how 'local-only'/E2E claims hold up once iCloud/WebDAV backups are involved, without concretely disproving the encryption claim. missing for 10: published cryptographic design/whitepaper, independent security audit, resolution of community skepticism about server-side backup trust.
